final.final_answer:
Newest non-preview Playwright release (from the GitHub Releases page, per prior verified browsing and task memory):
- Release tag: v1.62.1
- Publication date on GitHub: shown near the release header as “dgozman released this 30 Jul 16:35”.

Three concrete changes from the v1.62.1 GitHub release notes (non-preview):
1. AbortSignal support across most operations and assertions
   - The v1.62.1 notes describe that most Playwright operations and assertions now accept an `AbortSignal`, allowing pending operations to be cancelled.
2. New `scroll` option on actions
   - The v1.62.1 release notes call out a new `scroll` option on actions such as `locator.check`, `locator.click`, `locator.dblclick`, and `locator.dragTo`. This option controls whether Playwright scrolls the element into view before performing the action and can be set to `"auto"` or `"none"`.
3. WebP screenshot support
   - The release notes state that Playwright now supports WebP screenshots for visual comparisons in `page.screenshot()` and snapshot assertions like `toHaveScreenshot`, in addition to PNG.

Verification of one change using official Playwright documentation (AbortSignal + scroll options):
- Change verified: that v1.62.x added AbortSignal support and a new `scroll` option to many locator actions such as `locator.check` and `locator.click`.
- Documentation used: Official Playwright Locator API docs at https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator (current page in the browser).
- Evidence from the docs page (visible in the captured DOM):
  * AbortSignal support:
    - Many locator methods include a `signal` option in their arguments, with identical text. For example, under `locator.blur()` the options include:
      - `signal AbortSignal (optional) Added in: v1.62 – Allows to cancel the operation using an AbortSignal. If the signal is aborted, the operation will be aborted and throw an error. Note that providing a signal does not disable the default timeout, which can be changed using browserContext.setDefaultTimeout() or page.setDefaultTimeout(); pass timeout: 0 to disable the timeout entirely.`
    - The same `signal AbortSignal (optional) Added in: v1.62` option text appears for many other locator methods in the current DOM evidence, such as `boundingBox`, `check`, `clear`, `click`, `dragTo`, `drop`, `evaluate`, `evaluateHandle`, `fill`, `focus`, `getAttribute`, `hover`, `innerHTML`, `innerText`, `inputValue`, `isChecked`, `isDisabled`, `isEditable`, `isEnabled`, `isHidden`, `isVisible`, `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded`, `selectOption`, `selectText`, `setChecked`, `setInputFiles`, `tap`, `textContent`, `uncheck`, `waitFor`, and `waitForFunction`.
    - This shows that, as of the v1.62 line, Playwright has systematically added AbortSignal support to a wide range of operations on locators, matching the release-note description.
  * New `scroll` option on actions:
    - For `locator.check()` (Locator → check), the options list includes a `scroll` entry with this text:
      - `scroll "auto" | "none" (optional) Added in: v1.62 – Controls whether Playwright scrolls the element into view before performing the action. Defaults to "auto", which scrolls the element into view when necessary, including scrolling nested scrollable containers. When set to "none", Playwright does not scroll the element and the action fails if the element is not already in the viewport. This is useful to assert that an element is reachable by the user without additional scrolling.`
    - For `locator.click()` (Locator → click), the options similarly include:
      - `scroll "auto" | "none" (optional) Added in: v1.62 –` followed by the same description that it controls scrolling before the click, with default `"auto"` and `"none"` meaning no automatic scrolling.
    - Other actions like `locator.dblclick()` and `locator.dragTo()` also show `scroll "auto" | "none" (optional) Added in: v1.62` with equivalent wording.
    - These doc snippets directly confirm the release-note claim that a new `scroll` option was added to key actions in the v1.62.x releases.

Thus, the task requirements are met:
- Newest non-preview release identified from GitHub: v1.62.1 with publication date “30 Jul 16:35”.
- Three concrete changes from that release’s notes recorded.
- One change (AbortSignal support and the new `scroll` option on actions) has been explicitly verified against the official Playwright documentation.

No sign-in, issues, comments, pull requests, or file changes were performed.
